entries.cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am applying for the Senior AWS Fullstack Engineer position. I am a senior full-stack developer with extensive experience building, maintaining, and supporting production applications using C#, .NET, REST APIs, SQL Server, React, Next.js, and TypeScript.

My experience aligns with the role's focus on end-to-end delivery, dependable systems, and production ownership. I have built API-driven business applications, dashboards, customer portals, and data-driven workflows, while working across backend services, frontend interfaces, databases, deployments, monitoring, troubleshooting, and ongoing support. My recent work included Docker and IIS-based deployments, Azure DevOps workflows, production server migrations, SQL Server administration, and incident response during service downtime.

My recent professional experience has been primarily in the .NET and Microsoft ecosystem rather than AWS/CDK. However, I bring a strong foundation in full-stack architecture, cloud-adjacent deployment operations, API integration, relational databases, and maintaining business-critical systems. I am comfortable learning new infrastructure tooling and contributing immediately where my existing engineering and production-support experience can provide value.

I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my full-stack delivery and operational experience could support your team. My résumé is attached, and selected projects are available at https://justintagarda.com.

Thank you for your time and consideration.

Sincerely,
Justiniano Tagarda

entries.cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am applying for the Software Support Engineer position. I am a senior .NET backend and full-stack developer with extensive experience supporting production business systems, troubleshooting application and data issues, and translating operational needs into practical technical solutions.

My background aligns well with this role's focus on incident triage, diagnosis, resolution, documentation, and communication with clients and engineering teams. I have supported production APIs, SQL Server-backed workflows, dashboards, customer portals, and internal business applications. In my recent backend role, I monitored production infrastructure, provided incident support during service downtime, administered IIS and SQL Server environments, improved backend services and frontend data bindings, and led the migration of production websites, services, and databases to new Windows Server infrastructure.

I also bring experience working directly with clients and stakeholders to clarify requirements, reproduce problems, define solutions, and deliver maintainable software. My verified tools and technologies include SQL, C#, .NET, REST APIs, React, TypeScript, Docker, IIS, Azure DevOps, Jira, and Git-based development workflows.

My recent experience is stronger in .NET and Microsoft-based production systems than in Python, Azure administration, and Terraform infrastructure-as-code. However, I have a solid foundation in application support, SQL troubleshooting, infrastructure operations, and learning new technical environments. I would welcome the opportunity to contribute that experience while growing into the role's broader support and cloud tooling requirements.

My résumé is attached, and selected projects are available at https://justintagarda.com. Thank you for your time and consideration.

Sincerely,
Justiniano Tagarda

Dear Hiring Team,

I am applying for the Freelance Developer position focused on AI product prototyping and knowledge systems. I am a senior full-stack developer with extensive experience turning business ideas and requirements into usable web applications, dashboards, workflows, and production software using C#, .NET, React, Next.js, TypeScript, and REST APIs.

My background aligns with the role's need for someone who can work independently, organize complex information, learn new tools quickly, and turn concepts into structured, actionable product work. I have worked directly with clients to define scope, clarify requirements, refine functionality, and deliver maintainable software. I have also built data-driven interfaces, authentication flows, dashboards, internal business systems, and customer portals, while supporting projects through deployment, troubleshooting, and ongoing improvement.

I am comfortable researching unfamiliar domains, synthesizing requirements, documenting workflows, and collaborating closely with stakeholders. I also regularly use AI-assisted development tools and have a strong interest in applying emerging technologies to improve product delivery and business processes.

My verified experience is strongest in custom web application development rather than specific no-code platforms such as Notion, Webflow, Zapier, or Make. However, my product-development background gives me a solid technical foundation for learning those tools, organizing knowledge systems, building prototypes, and evaluating practical automation opportunities.

I would welcome the opportunity to support your product initiatives and work closely with the founder to turn ideas into clear, useful, and continuously improving solutions. My résumé is attached, and selected projects are available at https://justintagarda.com.

Thank you for your time and consideration.

Sincerely,
Justiniano Tagarda
